title: Integrations
description: Connect accounts once, then choose which apps can use them.
unavailable: The integration service is unavailable. Check Nimi and try again.
name: Connection name
custody: Nimi Runtime keeps credentials. Allowed apps receive a connection reference and the results of their permitted operations.
telegramMode: Reply collection uses one shared receiver. Existing webhooks must be managed at their source; this form does not remove them.
connected: Connected. Select operations and apps to allow below.
allowApps: Allow apps to use an integration
permissionHelp: One choice permits these operations during normal and background use. You can revoke an app independently.
providerOffline: The providing app is offline. Its description is available; calls will fail until it is running.
verificationRequired: Verify this bot's identity to keep using the existing connection. Permissions and the reply position will be retained.
verified: Connection verified. Existing permissions and reply position are retained.
allowed: The selected permissions have been saved.
empty: Connect a service or run an app that provides an integration.
unavailablePermissionConsumer: New permissions are unavailable for this instance. Existing permissions can still be revoked.
unavailablePermissionSource: The source is currently unavailable. Its permissions are retained.
noPermissions: No apps have been allowed yet.
recordsHelp: Up to 100 recent calls. Call facts are retained for at most 30 days; credentials and private content are omitted.
unknownAttribution: Name not recorded at the time
homeBody: Connect accounts, allow apps and review recent use.

errors.INTEGRATION_MANAGEMENT_DENIED: This connection does not have Nimi Home management access.
errors.INTEGRATION_TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_CONFLICT: This bot already uses a webhook. Select a dedicated test bot or manage its receiver at the source.
errors.INTEGRATION_TELEGRAM_BOT_ALREADY_CONNECT: This bot already has a connection. Select it from the existing integrations and allow the apps that need it.
errors.INTEGRATION_TELEGRAM_VERIFICATION_REQUIR: Select this connection and verify the bot's identity first.
errors.INTEGRATION_TELEGRAM_IDENTITY_INVALID: Telegram did not return a valid bot identity. Check the credential and try again.
errors.INTEGRATION_NEW_TARGET_REQUIRED: Create a new connection for a different account or service.
errors.INTEGRATION_PROVIDER_REJECTED: The service rejected this configuration. Check the account details.
errors.INTEGRATION_DISCOVERY_FAILED: The service did not provide a usable operation catalog.
errors.INTEGRATION_ENDPOINT_INVALID: Enter a valid HTTPS MCP service address.
